cloneGroupAnalysis.groupSizePattern: 1 seed + 3 company-name-rotated clones per group (4x multiplier)
cloneGroupAnalysis.cloneRotationMechanics: Template-based item generation. Same stem with different company names rotated across clones. Distractors are template-generated (identical across clones). Only the company name and correct-choice letter differ.
cloneGroupAnalysis.rootCause: Pre-2026 content generation pipeline produced 4 variants per seed to fill pack quotas. Template engine rotated company names and shuffled correct-choice letters without creating pedagogically distinct items.

replacementRequirements.strategy: 1 replacement item per clone group — consolidate from 4 variants to 1 unique item per topic
replacementRequirements.strategyCertification: Full CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification of retained seeds. Author EW for all distractors. Verify no DL-008/DL-013/DL-026/DL-031 defects.
